parameters.name: CaCertificate
parameters.description: The CA certificate used to verify the server certificate of the keyless server. This parameter applies only when `Verify` is set to `true`.

parameters.name: ClientCertificate
parameters.description: The client certificate. This parameter must be used with the `ClientPrivateKey` parameter.

parameters.name: ClientPrivateKey
parameters.description: The client private key. This parameter must be used with the `ClientCertificate` parameter.

parameters.name: Host
parameters.description: The hostname of the keyless server. The value can be a domain name or an IP address.

parameters.name: SiteId
parameters.description: The site ID. You can obtain this ID by calling the [ListSites](~~2850189~~) operation.

parameters.name: Verify
parameters.description: Specifies whether to verify the server certificate of the keyless server. Default: false.
